Running Resnet50 on AMD 6900XT with Vulkan reports


Compiler

amdgpu from upstream 6.0.0-rc4 kernel with latest `amdvulkan` drivers built from source. 

IREE is top of master.

_No response_

issue.body:
BuiltinExecutables would need to create dummy descriptor sets as placeholders. For such sets, we can set them to have zero bindings. This gives us a singal to avoid turning on push VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR bit when creating descriptor sets. Otherwise we would create multiple descriptor sets all with that bit and thus causing validation errors:

```
Validation Error: [ VUID-VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo-pSetLayouts-00293 ]
vkCreatePipelineLayout() Multiple push descriptor sets found. The Vulkan
spec states: pSetLayouts must not contain more than one descriptor set
layout that was created with VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR set
```

Fixes https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/10414
